name: window_main
source: var r=[Window.mainWindow===null];var a=new Window(),b=new Window();r.add(Window.mainWindow===a);r.add(typeof a.mainWindow);invalidate a;r.add(Window.mainWindow===null);var c=new Window();r.add(Window.mainWindow===null);invalidate b;invalidate c;var d=new Window();r.add(Window.mainWindow===d);return r.join("|");

name: window_lifetime
source: global.log=[];class C{var name;function C(n){name=n;}function finalize(){global.log.add(name);}}var w=new Window(),a=new C("a"),b=new C("b"),c=new C("c");w.add(a);w.add(a);w.add(b);w.add(c);w.remove(b);invalidate w;return [log.join(","),isvalid a,isvalid b,isvalid c].join("|");

name: window_lifetime_reentrant
source: global.log=[];global.w=new Window();class C{var n;function C(v){n=v;}function finalize(){global.log.add(n);global.w.remove(global.b);global.w.add(global.c);if(n==1)throw "failure";}}global.a=new C(1);global.b=new C(2);global.c=new C(3);w.add(a);w.add(b);invalidate w;return [log.join(","),isvalid a,isvalid b,isvalid c].join("|");

name: native_base_constructor

name: window_border_style_super
source: class W extends Window{function W(){super.Window();}property borderStyle{getter(){return super.borderStyle;}setter(v){super.borderStyle=v;}}}var w=new W(),r=[w.borderStyle];for(var i=0;i<6;i++){w.borderStyle=i;r.add(w.borderStyle);}return r.join(",");
